declaration.intent: Identify provider names assigned to multiple distinct provider IDs and inspect those candidate duplicate pairs.

args.sql: SELECT provider_name, COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT provider_id) AS ids, GROUP_CONCAT(provider_id) AS provider_ids, GROUP_CONCAT(service_code) AS services, GROUP_CONCAT(region) AS regions FROM data GROUP BY provider_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT provider_id) > 1 ORDER BY provider_name

payload: ticket=tkt_656bb7 (valid for one call to csv_query on target '/data/public/providers.csv')

declaration.intent: Check case- and whitespace-normalized provider names for repeated identities under different IDs, beyond exact-name matches.

args.sql: SELECT lower(trim(provider_name)) AS normalized_name, COUNT(DISTINCT provider_id) AS ids, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT provider_id) AS provider_ids, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT provider_name) AS name_forms, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT service_code) AS services, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT region) AS regions FROM data GROUP BY lower(trim(provider_name)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT provider_id) > 1 ORDER BY normalized_name
